purpose: Measure technical and provenance feasibility of scalable issuer-IR discovery and official-body capture for the frozen 1,355-group EARNINGS_EPS R1 queue. This probe does not authorize event-truth verification or marginal-N promotion.

sample.selection_rule: Within each year, rank rows ascending by SHA256('W4C-R1-EIR-DP-v1.0|' + exact_group_id) hex digest and take the first 20. No source, outcome, price, liquidity, linked-return, PnL or model information may enter selection.

probe_tasks: Derive a navigation query only from frozen pretruth subject/date metadata.
Attempt to locate an issuer-controlled investor-relations or corporate-news URL using a general web index/search surface; search/index metadata is navigation-only and cannot vote.
Fetch the candidate official issuer body directly.
Record URL, final domain, HTTP status, retrieval timestamp, body hash when retrievable, and deterministic identity-token checks derived from frozen metadata.
Do not inspect or persist EPS/revenue/guidance numeric results for truth classification.

technical_success_definition.navigation_found: At least one candidate issuer-controlled URL is located.
technical_success_definition.official_body_retrievable: Candidate issuer URL returns a retrievable body directly from the issuer-controlled domain.
technical_success_definition.identity_bindable: Body/domain contains sufficient issuer identity tokens to bind the site to the frozen company subject without relying on a third-party snippet.

capacity_decision_rule.FULL_ROUTE_TECHNICALLY_VIABLE: At least 24/40 sampled groups have probe_success and at least 16/20 succeed in neither year? false; instead require >=10/20 in each year to avoid a one-year-only route.
capacity_decision_rule.CONDITIONAL_ROUTE: Overall probe_success is 12-23/40 or either year has 5-9/20 successes; redesign only transport/navigation, never matching semantics, before another frozen probe.
capacity_decision_rule.ROUTE_INFEASIBLE_CURRENT_PROTOCOL: Fewer than 12/40 probe_success or either year has fewer than 5/20 successes after deterministic transport retries.
capacity_decision_rule.note: Thresholds govern technical route continuation only, not scientific truth or N promotion.
